news.contents: New England Patriots running back TreVeyon Henderson (illness) was placed on injured reserve Saturday and will miss at least four more games. The Patriots had already ruled him out for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions in Munich and listed him as a nonparticipant Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday. Henderson last played in Week 7 and said on Nov. 6 that he had been hospitalized for several days after experiencing unexplained neurological symptoms.
